newsitem.title: USA: Choice for Fed posts narrowed by White House.
newsitem.headline: Choice for Fed posts narrowed by White House.

text.p: The Clinton administration has narrowed its choice for replacements to two Federal Reserve governor positions and hopes to decide on them as soon as possible, White House economic adviser Gene Sperling told a briefing for reporters Friday.
He said that a banking background was one consideration in making a choice but made clear that it was not the only one being examined by the White House.
"With completion now of the State of the Union and the budget, I hope we will move expeditiously," he said.
